risk_notes.text: Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac remain in FHFA conservatorship since September 2008; they trade OTC (FNMA/FMCC). Any recap/release or administrative action is a binary event for agency MBS pricing.
US commercial banks hold roughly $2.7T of agency MBS (Fed H.8) — the single largest private holder class. HTM unrealized losses remain a balance-sheet overhang when rates rise.

risk_notes.source: Federal Reserve Bank of New York
risk_notes.text: NY Fed primary dealer roster stands at ~24-26 firms (MUFG Securities Americas added Jan 2026; SMBC Nikko added 2025). Dealers must bid pro-rata in all Treasury auctions and make markets for the Desk.
ON RRP facility effectively drained (~$1.5B, Oct 2026) — the money-fund liquidity buffer is gone, so Treasury issuance now draws directly from bank reserves.
